PAULINE LITTLE Pauline Little (formerly Fingler) passed away peacefully at the Concordia Hospital on August 27, 2007, at the age of 89. She was predeceased by her husband of 36 years, Donald Little, on July 4, 2007, and her first husband of 25 years, Adolph (Eddie) Fingler, in March 1963. Pauline leaves to mourn her passing her children, Gerry (Anita) Fingler, Norm (Debbie) Fingler, Al (Shirley) Fingler, Ken Fingler, Glenn Fingler and Cindy (Mike) Mencik; her grandchildren, Kerry (Brenda) Fingler, Randy Fingler, Derek (Anne) Fingler, Dan (Sherry) Fingler, Aynsley Hare, Dayna Fingler, Pam Fingler, Jeff Fingler, Peter Fingler and Brett Mencik; her great-grandchildren, Lauren Fingler, Brandon Fingler, Trevor Fingler, Logan Fingler, Joseph Fingler, Thomas Fingler, Benjamin Fingler, Alexe Fingler, Alyssa Hare and Zachary Hare. Funeral services will be held at 11:00 a.m. on Tuesday, September 4 at Grace Lutheran Church, 211 Kimberly Avenue, Winnipeg. Viewing will begin one hour prior to service. Pauline will be laid to rest in Brookside Cemetery. In lieu of flowers, donations may be made to Grace Lutheran Church. Arrangements entrusted to: KLASSEN FUNERAL HOME 1897 Henderson Hwy. - 338-0331 www.klassenfuneralhome.com

As published in Winnipeg Free Press on Sep 01, 2007
